mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in the prior month signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing future earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not cross above 4.5% in the prior month, or 5-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (housing starts) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust demand across sectors, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rise above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise above their 3-month moving averages, or 20d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, eroding consumer and corporate confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise by >0.3pp in 3 months, or 20d returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (industrial production) over the past quarter reflects stronger supply-side activity, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained upward trend over the quarter, or 60d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a drop in UNRATE below 9.5% signals momentum in the labor market, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 9.5% in the late-cycle regime, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (residential construction) above their 3-month moving averages simultaneously indicate strong demand in both consumption and housing sectors, accelerating corporate growth and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS does not rise above their 3-month moving averages, or 5d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS exceeding 4% signals higher interest rates, compressing equity discount rates and reducing future cash flow valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% in a monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4% in the tightening cycle, or 20d returns are not negative.
